name: Grade 7 IIIT Practice: October Week 3 - Data Analysis
description: Practice words for sorting, filtering, and patterns.

words.example: Sort arranged the scores from highest to lowest.

words.definition: To show only data that matches a rule.
words.example: The filter showed only students who completed the task.

words.definition: A spreadsheet function that counts items matching a condition.
words.example: COUNTIF counted how many scores were 80 or higher.

words.definition: Changing how text or data looks.
words.example: Formatting made the header bold and the totals easy to see.

words.definition: Something that repeats or has a clear order.
words.example: The pattern showed that scores rose after extra practice.

words.definition: A rule that can be true or false.
words.example: The condition counted only values above the passing score.
